explanation: Compared against OEIS A238585 (Sun): a(n) = #{primes p < n : prime(p)² + (prime(n)−1)² prime}; conjecture (i): a(n) > 0 unless n divides 6. The Lean `a` sums over p ∈ [1, n) with p prime and uses Nat.nth Nat.Prime (k−1) for the 1-indexed prime(k), matching the Mathematica program; test values agree with the data. The statement for n > 0 is 0 < a n ↔ ¬ n ∣ 6; the reverse-direction content (a(n) = 0 for n = 1, 2, 3, 6) is confirmed by the OEIS data, so the iff is an accurate reading of 'unless'. Faithful.
